title: Exact Relational Mechanics and Certified Sign Boundaries of the Fermi-Hubbard Model: Diagonal Sign Gauges, Auxiliary-Field Palindromic Symmetries, and Explicit Negative Witnesses
description: Exact algebraic evaluations of the Fermi-Hubbard model on finite graphs using pure rational arithmetic in SQLite, demonstrating exchange loop sign obstructions on physical trees, palindromic kinetic Suzuki symmetries, protected determinant sectors, and explicit negative field existence witnesses.
